foundation.reuse_decision: Use the existing gate + manifest contract exactly as built; do not create a new builder or runtime for this proof.

phase_2_same_body_routed_green.criterion: With this same-PR prospective manifest present and the fixture itself unchanged, JM Build Entry Gate must recognize authority.work_pr=143 and pass.

manifest_contract.criterion: Validate JM Build Route Manifests must accept this prospective manifest structurally without treating structural validity as runtime/contact proof.

escalation.manual_user_contact: Not required for this proof because the claimed behavior is the GitHub Actions entry gate itself.
